reference.why: Stephen gave no visual reference, and demo-psychotherapist is the closest register of the nine for a senior, warm, academic psychotherapist and author: a refined Cormorant Garamond serif over a calm full-width photographic hero, a portrait intro, a pull quote, service cards, testimonials and a quiet CTA band. Deviations decided before building: the palette is trusty-blue instead of forest-and-cream because his own Lake District photographs are lake blue, slate, muted fell green and warm sunrise, and trusty-blue carries exactly those; the nav is two-tier because his site has eight menu items and the brand row carries his phone; the home page adds an experience figures band (stats--warm) because his Welcome page leads with those figures, and the service cards are photo cards using his own seven 300px Lake District photographs, which suit a card's size; the demo's single multi-service page becomes four sibling service pages (his own information architecture), each a page-header, a split with a calm Lake District photograph, a component band for his lists, a testimonial band and a CTA band; testimonials carry no star ratings because he never gave any; the quote is his own (the Dalai Lama line from his Links page). After the blind critic (12-11-2026): home shows three photo cards plus a numbered service-list for the other three offers; a warm sand band (band--2) and a soft sage band (band--3) give the second and third calm tints; inner page headers carry a calm Lake District photograph (page-header--image) because the home hero is an image hero; his seven 300px slider photos are too small for any slot on the new layout, so they serve as style references for the generated images instead.
